cases.injected_condition: Direct or batch HTML is supplied with text omitted, explicit, or empty
cases.required_outcome: Omitted text is derived before persistence and MIME accounting; explicit text is unchanged; empty text with HTML remains an opt-out.
No partial message or idempotency claim is retained.
The committed item remains due and observable.
A duplicate deterministic job is safe.
Only one active claimant owns a lease.
The submission is not retried and recipient records retain a terminal reason category.
The submission uses bounded retry with backoff.
The ambiguity is recorded and measurable.
The immutable event is deduplicated and recipient state does not regress.
Both recipient outcomes remain canonical and the message aggregate is deterministic.

cases.injected_condition: Mixed recipient outcomes, an old in-flight attempt, queue backlog, and adversarial private fields
cases.required_outcome: Scoped API and CLI output retains canonical recipient and recovery state while omitting addresses, content, credentials, signed URLs, provider identifiers, raw errors, and unrecognized fields.
Bounded orphan cleanup removes the unreferenced object.
Automatic retries retain one stable event ID.
Retry is safe or a tested rollback is documented.
No message content, address, credential, signed URL, or raw provider error leaves the data plane.
